title: Contact American Education and Translation Services (AET)
description: Choose one AET office to request translation, credential evaluation, interpretation, or notary services.
introHeading: Please contact only one office to avoid delays. Choose from the following four options:

options.title: Phone
options.body: Call one of our offices using the phone numbers listed in its contact details. Please check the office’s business hours before calling.

options.title: Email
options.body: Send a scanned copy of your document to one of our offices via email. We will reply with the quote and time as soon as possible. Original documents are not needed for certified translation and foreign credential evaluation.

options.title: WeChat
options.body: For offices with a WeChat ID, add the listed ID in WeChat to ask about our services. You can find it under “More ways to reach this office” in the office’s contact details.

options.title: Visit
options.body: Visit our office with your document. A reservation is required for the San Francisco office; other offices do not require an appointment.
